q: Which vessel has the thickest wall?
How many times higher is pressure in an artery than in a vein?
Explain why arteries have thick walls.
Blood is pumped from the heart at high pressure; thick, elastic, muscular walls withstand the pressure without bursting.
Explain how the capillary data fit its job.
A wall only 0.001 mm (one cell) thick gives a short distance for diffusion of oxygen and glucose; a very narrow width puts blood close to every cell.
